main_text.p: πας, πα, paterculus. Aliquando etiam in as purum, ut Παυσανίας, παυσανία, Paufa-nias: παϝαλοίας, παϝαλοία, parricida: λάας, λάα, lapis. Dorice etiam declinatur Χρύσας, χρύσα, pro communi Χρύσης, ν, Chryfes. Dorici etiam putantur illi ca-fus, Τρης, Τρη: Δρης, Δρη: Ποδης, Ποδη: Μαναοσης, Μαναοση: Μωϋσης, Μωϋση. Ex diminutiva illa, Διονυς, Διονυ, Dionyfius: Καμις, καμι Camillus. item Ἰησους Iefus, ἰησου, ἰησω, ἰησου. Hæc omnia datiuum habent sine ι.
main_text.head: Anomalia vocativi.

p.i: Quatuor generum nominativi ns mutatur vocativo in a breve.

main_text.p: 1. Primò in nominibus in της, ut ληστης, ληστα, prædo. sic ἱππηλάτης equitator, προφήτης propheta, τοξότης sagittarius. At poetice quatuor retinent η, Αἰήτης Æetes, ἀναρέτης virtute gravis, Καλλιπίτης Callipetes, Φιλοθερ- Philother-
Note: the Greek and Latin in this page are printed in mixed type; doubtful readings are given in notes.

page.notes: Greek words are transcribed from the scan as best read; accents and breathings on several forms are uncertain. Line "Philother-" appears twice because the final line of the page is partly repeated at the catchword position; the catchword is the broken word at the foot. Some Greek forms (Παυσανίας, Ἰησους, Τρης etc.) may contain printing or scan errors and are not checked against originals.
